title: Global Loover Medium Back Weight Sensing Synchro-Tilter Chair
body_html:
A task chair that tunes itself to whoever sits down — no levers, no guesswork, just balanced support from the first recline.

The Global Loover Medium Back Synchro-Tilter uses a Weight Sensing mechanism that automatically calibrates tilt tension to each user's body weight, making it a natural fit for shared institutional workstations. A Vue mesh back combines elastic and non-stretch fibers for flexible lumbar support, while three-way adjustable armcaps, a side-activated sliding seat and Global's quiet Soft Descent pneumatic lift round out the ergonomic package. Built in Canada on a fiberglass-reinforced nylon base in polished aluminum, it measures W25.5" x D24" x H39.5".

Key features

  • Weight Sensing Synchro-Tilter automatically adjusts reclining tilt-tension to each user's body weight
  • Vue mesh back combines elastic and non-stretch fibers for flexible, custom lumbar support
  • Three-way adjustable armcaps (height, depth and width)
  • Side-activated sliding seat depth adjustment
  • Soft Descent pneumatic lift lowers the seat gently and quietly
  • Five-legged fiberglass-reinforced nylon base in polished aluminum finish

Who it’s for

Private offices, administrative workstations and shared-use desking in municipal, education and healthcare environments where ergonomic comfort is needed across users of different sizes.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
